title: Various Aspects Of Rule Under Khiljis
definition: The Khilji Dynasty (1290–1320 AD) marked the 'Imperialist Phase' of the Delhi Sultanate, characterized by the transition from a tribal-military oligarchy to a centralized, autocratic, and expansionist state.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested for its radical economic reforms (Market Regulations), military centralization, and the shift in the nature of kingship from 'First among equals' to 'Absolute Despot'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Various Aspects Of Rule Under Khiljis.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
